stem:
Bela compares two snack packets. One lists more protein and fibre and less sugar.

Which better fits a health-minded choice from the labels?

options.text: The packet with the brighter cartoon, ignoring the table.
The packet with more protein and fibre and less sugar, from the nutrition table.
The sweeter packet, because taste is the only nutrient.

teacher.key_rationale: Compare the nutrition table, not the cartoon. Sugar is not the only nutrient.
